svg.title: PostgreSQL data model
svg.desc: Data model. documents contains id, content, metadata, status, chunk_count, created_at, file_name, file_type, s3_key, content_preview, doc_type, fingerprint, last_error, updated_at, completed_at, collection and text_source. chunks contains id, document_id, chunk_index, text, token_count and created_at. document_fingerprints contains fingerprint, document_id and created_at. ingest_jobs contains document_id, state, attempts, lease_owner, lease_until, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at and updated_at. Each child references documents.id with cascading deletion. A document has zero or more chunks and fingerprints and at most one ingestion job. PK denotes primary key and FK denotes foreign key; SQL types appear beside every column. Fingerprints are scoped to the collection; document_fingerprints stores the scoped digest.
